title: Chapter 300 The Backhand Comes Into Play
content:
Chapter 300 The Backhand Comes Into Play

Not many people present could break through Falati's defense.

As soon as they came up, everyone used their most powerful moves.

Falati was stunned. When he recovered, his health had been reduced by one tenth.

"You damn bugs, prepare to bear my wrath!"

Falati's body was blazing with flames, and the temperature around him seemed to have risen by several degrees.

Gong Zheng hugged Falati tightly from behind, and the flames burned on his petrified skin, gradually tending to burn him into a red stone man.

Wang Shuo looked back and saw that there were still some remaining, the Golden Fire Cavalry and the Hell Knights, who had not entered the valley.

It seemed that they needed to buy some more time.

"Roots Entangled"

Goode released the control skill.

Wang Shuo and Goode took turns using the control skills to delay time.

They also tried to kill Falati, but it was obvious that it was impossible in a short time.

In just a moment, Wang Shuo and others had lost more than half of their health.

They had to use diluted water of life to replenish it continuously.

Finally, when all the troops retreated into the valley, Wang Shuo and others also fought and retreated.

Not long after, the Undead Knights entered the valley.

Wang Shuo was a little excited.

Li Jianguo, standing on a high place, immediately threw the prepared boulders into the canyon.

Falati looked up and saw countless boulders rolling down, and many Undead Knights were directly knocked off their horses.

Moreover, at the entrance of the valley, a large number of boulders fell and blocked the gap.

He immediately realized that he was ambushed.

At this moment, a large number of thunders fell again and exploded in the valley.

"Bang..."

Countless explosions echoed in the valley.

Thunders seemed to be free, like rain.

The Undead Knights in the valley were constantly blown to death, and even the valley was blown down!

Falati's eyes burned with angry flames.

"Wang Shuo, dare you fight me?"

His angry roar echoed in the valley, and it could be distinguished even in the explosion.

Wang Shuo hid in the valley. Because he was afraid of accidental injury, he did not cast the thunderbolt where the two sides met.

Wang Shuo looked at the mad Falati with contempt.

"Idiot, do you think you can still escape?"

Wang Shuo wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and smiled.

At this time, the number of undead knights in the valley was less than a thousand, and most of them were seriously injured and their combat power was halved.

Seeing that the time was ripe, Wang Shuo shouted: "Kill!"

Falati looked at the three-headed dog troops who were counterattacking, and he couldn't help feeling a little desperate.

I was careless!

I thought the other party was already trapped, but I didn't expect that the clown was me!

He roared unwillingly, waving the spear in his hand quickly. There was no way to escape, so let's fight to the last moment!

Wang Shuo also gave his opponent enough respect and did not use the bronze crossbow cart to kill him, mainly because the terrain was not easy to deploy.

The main generals of the Red Flame Army surrounded him, and finally Falati died in the valley.

[You killed Falati, a top-level general at level 58, ID: Dragon DW0002547. ]

[You led the Red Flame Army to defeat the Undead Knights of the Burning Legion, reputation value +500, command value +5. ]

Wang Shuo was relieved when he heard the system prompt.

After cleaning the battlefield, Wang Shuo got 400,000 energy crystals and 14,000 soul crystals.

It must be said that the high-level undead dropped quite a lot, and Wang Shuo also got a gold-quality helmet and a resuscitation necklace.

[Resuscitation necklace: After equipping, energy +10, mental power recovery speed increased by 100%. ]

Wang Shuo is still using the rebound necklace, which is really a bit shabby.

After putting on the recovery necklace, he instantly felt a sense of clarity of mind.

After Wang Shuo removed the huge rock that blocked the canyon, the scene outside made Wang Shuo alert.
